messages:
alex_customer: Hey team, noticed something weird — our account shows free-tier credits being consumed after a promotional credit bundle. Dashboard usage graph shows free credits used first, but the invoice line items applied the promo credits first and left us with a small charge. Can you confirm which ordering we should expect?

jamie_support: Sorry for the trouble, Alex. Can you share the account id and the time window? This sounds like a burn-order mismatch. :thinking_face:

alex_customer: Account: acct_9XK4ZZ, noticed on 2025-11-18 02:14 UTC-ish. Invoice dated 2025-11-18 00:00 shows promo credits applied first. Dashboard (UI) shows remaining free-tier credits dropping only after promo bundle fully used.
jamie_support: Thanks. Looping in billing for priority rules — @ana_billing can you take a look? I'll grab logs. :mag:

ana_billing: On it. A quick note: billing system should apply credits by priority: (1) pool/promo with explicit expiry order, (2) free-tier roll-forward, (3) paid balance. But there are edge cases when promo activation timestamps are very close to usage events — leads to race. Do you have example request IDs or a raw usage event time range?
alex_customer: I pulled the first offending request id: req_20251118_00a7. Also saw these usage events in raw_events table: 
```
2025-11-18T00:01:07Z req_20251118_00a7 tokens=124
2025-11-18T00:01:07Z req_20251118_00a8 tokens=862
2025-11-18T00:01:09Z promo_activate acct_9XK4ZZ promo_id=PROMO-XXXX
```
(so activation ~2s after initial requests)

mike_engineer: That timing is critical. Metering service stamps usage with an ingestion_ts and then a credit_assignment job processes batches every N seconds. If promo activation arrives milliseconds after ingestion but before credit_assignment runs, assignment order can flip depending on queue ordering.

ana_billing: Exactly. If activation_ts > ingestion_ts but coupon.source_priority is higher, we still expected promo to be backfilled by the post-processing pass — but I see a ticket where the backfill failed due to a schema change in the last deploy. Investigating.
jamie_support: Can you confirm whether we should credit-adjust the invoice immediately for the customer? They were charged ~$3.24 due to this.

ana_billing: If we can prove application order mismatch, yes, issue a manual invoice credit and mark as corrected. I'll need the following to complete: account id, invoice number, list of request ids, and the activation event id. You have acct_9XK4ZZ, invoice INV-20251118-9X, and req_20251118_00a7/00a8 — do you also have the promo activation event id?
alex_customer: Activation event id is evt_20251118_0932 (seen in webhook log). Invoice # is correct. Thanks.

mike_engineer: For engineering triage: repro steps I used locally against staging metering db: 
```
-- simulate ingestion arriving before promo activation
INSERT INTO raw_events (ts, req_id, tokens) VALUES ('2025-11-18T00:01:07Z','req_test_1',100);
-- promo applied 2s later
INSERT INTO promo_events (ts, account_id, promo_id) VALUES ('2025-11-18T00:01:09Z','acct_9XK4ZZ','PROMO-XXXX');
-- run assignment job
CALL assign_credits_batch(now());
SELECT * FROM credit_assignments WHERE req_id='req_test_1';
```
I saw assignment to free-tier instead of promo in staging when the post-processing backfill path was skipped (bugging in v2.3.1).

jamie_support: Good repro. Ana — does that align with billing logs?

ana_billing: Yes, billing audit shows assignment entries: 
```
credit_assignment: req_20251118_00a7 -> free_tier (applied_at=2025-11-18T00:01:11Z)
promo_backfill_pass: promo_id=PROMO-XXXX skipped due to schema mismatch
```
This confirms a backfill skip. We'll refund the charged amount and mark invoice corrected. I'll file the adjustment and cc finance.
billing-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: Create credit memo for INV-20251118-9X - amount $3.24. Ticket #BILL-8742 created.

alex_customer: Thanks. Quick question — will future activations that land shortly after usage be handled automatically once the deploy fix is out? Or should we expect more manual fixes?
mike_engineer: Once the backfill path fix is deployed (PR opened, rolling out to prod now), future close-timing activations will be backfilled during the next assignment pass. For safety we've added an extra deterministic sort key so assignment favors promo when activation_ts <= usage_ts + 5s window.

ana_billing: ETA: manual credit issued within 2 business hours, engineering rollback/patch in prod within 1 hour (hotfix), monitoring alert added to detect skipped backfills.
jamie_support: I'll reply to Alex with the next steps and the ticket links. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

alex_customer: Appreciate it. Please confirm when invoice is updated and when the hotfix is live.

jamie_support: Will do — keeping this P1 until we confirm credit memo and hotfix live.
